review_text:
Sometimes a product isn’t flashy or stylish, but it’s so extremely useful that it still stands out. That’s what we have here. For your convenience, I’ll divide the rest of this review between the pickup pen and the mats.

First let’s talk about the pen. Now, this isn’t the first telescoping pickup device I’ve used. For years, my household has had a couple of little ones laying around, in case we dropped something behind the couch or under the radiator. You probably know the sort: They look and function almost exactly like presentation pointers, except they have a small magnet at the tip that can pick up anything from a paperclip to a very small screw. Last year, my wife got one at the other end of the size chart, which collapses to the size of the average flashlight, but slightly narrower, with a large and powerful magnet at the end. This product lies in the Goldilocks zone between those others. It’s compact and narrow compared to my wife’s macro-gadget, with a nice ergonomic grip and a pocket clip. The magnet is slightly smaller than hers, allowing it to fit into places hers can’t, but still powerful enough to lift virtually anything I can anticipate wanting to use it on. Screws and hand tools? This pen will do the job. Pot lid? No problem. Lawnmower? No, but that would be stupid to try anyway. It’s solidly constructed, easy to use, and convenient to carry or store. Whoever designed it clearly understood the assignment.

Okay, now the mats. Honestly, I wasn’t sure I needed these when I placed the order, but they looked like they might come in handy to stop screws or nails from rolling away while I was working. Generally I’ve relied on the old trick of using a small drinking cup, but I was open to an upgrade. My expectations weren’t that high. I figured maybe the mats would hold on well enough that minor bumps from working or a light breeze wouldn’t send me scrambling for the pickup pen, but not much more. This is one of those times I was delighted to be wrong. These mats have a strong magnetic field! Sure, I can lay them out on a work table, but they’ll also stick securely to a vertical surface! I sometimes need to take apart our window air conditioners for cleaning, and now I’ll be able to slap one of the pads on the unit’s outer casing and just stick the screws to it as I remove them from the unit, confident that they’ll stay securely in place until I need them for reassembly! The mats feel sturdy and adhere well. Full marks! Glad the set includes three of them, because my wife very quickly claimed one for her projects!

Overall, this is one of those products that’s well thought out and well executed. I’d buy it again without hesitation.
